name: Tarpon Lawn & Pest
photo_verification_note: Of 11 provided Maps photo URLs: 1 is the business's own branded logo card (confirms name and 'lawn and pest control' tagline, not used in the site body due to text overlay), 1 duplicates that same logo image under a different URL, and 2 (a wide fenced pool yard and a pile of loose gravel/mulch) were dropped as too generic/unverifiable per a stricter internal-consistency pass. The 6 used in the build (sod install front yard, pool/patio landscaping x3, landscape bed, crew installing sod) all show plausible, coherent lawn/landscape work with no other company's branding, signage or text overlay.

reviewSamples.author: Brandon Buck
reviewSamples.text: Rian did an awesome job on my backyard and front. He wasn't pushy at all and was good working within my budget. Even covered some extra materials they needed outside the original quote. Great experience, will be hiring again!

reviewSamples.author: Anoosha Baladi
reviewSamples.text: We had an incredible experience working with Rian! He and his partner installed about 3,000 sq. ft. of sod along with a new irrigation system in both our front and backyard, and the results are amazing.

reviewSamples.author: Victoria Walsh
reviewSamples.text: I have been working with Tarpon Lawn and Pest for the past 4 years and we just wrapped up our largest project yet, sod on the entire property and correcting all the irrigation (we had a pool installed and the builder broke every line).

reviewSamples.author: Chrissy Maloney
reviewSamples.text: We are extremely happy with the work Rian & his partner did on my landscape project. From start to finish, their communication was clear, prompt, and professional.

reviewSamples.author: Greg Schrager
reviewSamples.text: Extremely happy with my experience with Tarpon Lawn. They were extremely professional, and we could not be happier with the landscaping work they performed. Would not hesitate to hire them again.

service_verification.method: web search (Thumbtack listing, Mapquest listing, general web search) since the business has no own website, Facebook or Instagram found
service_verification.findings: Thumbtack profile for 'Tarpon Lawn and Pest' (listed under Valrico/St. Petersburg, FL, sodding category) states the business specializes in landscape renovation, irrigation repairs/installs, and monthly lawn & ornamental pest control treatments, and does not provide mowing. This matches all 5 Google reviews, which describe sod installation, irrigation system installation/repair and landscape projects. No review or listing mentions general/structural pest control (termites, rodents, etc.) - only lawn & ornamental pest treatments are confirmed.

nicho: landscaping & lawn pest control (sod, irrigation, landscape design, lawn & ornamental pest control)
